title: Dodge Viper ACR vs Corvette ZR1: The Real Difference
description:
Two American supercars, both with a six-speed Tremec manual gearbox. One has a supercharged six point two litre V eight. The other has an eight point four litre V ten, and no turbochargers at all. One is the Chevrolet Corvette Z R one, the other the Dodge Viper A C R. And according to published Nürburgring times, the car with less power was the one that lapped faster. This is the real difference between them. Here is the twist. The Z R one had more power than the Viper that it raced against. It was also almost the same weight as the track-only Viper. Yet the numbers show a gap of seven and a half seconds on the Nürburgring, in the Viper's favour. We will show you where those numbers come from, and why you should read them carefully.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
